# OneStreamer (canned parse output for PAPERBRIEF_OFFLINE=1)

## Abstract

We present OneStreamer, a streaming video LLM that unifies perception, memory and proactive response.

## Results

OneStreamer reaches an average of 71.4 on StreamBench, 6.3 above the previous best (65.1). See Figure 1.
